### **Summary**

The session focused on platform feature enhancements and administrative workflows, culminating in merged registration profiles and fraud updates.

**Platform Functionality and Features**  
Admins will manage event options and ticket proofs directly via the dashboard to improve oversight. Fraud prevention measures now include location-based verification for QR codes to ensure attendee presence.

**Profiles and Payment Controls**  
The platform will merge artist and event organizer registration categories to streamline the onboarding flow. Reward payouts are strictly restricted to administrators to maintain financial control.

**Administrative and Configuration Updates**  
Email branding and notification settings will be fully editable within the administrative portal. Backend logic for bug reporting and budget deductions will be implemented to ensure accuracy.

### **Decisions**

## Aligned

* **Multiple events per campaign allowed** The platform will allow the attachment of multiple events to a single campaign, though sponsorship acceptance closes the campaign once a selection is made. \- admin now in this case should be able too see what what event was selected here. Give them edit option as in the admin only view \- but confirmation popup if selected by user tried to change here on this side.

* **Sponsorship acceptance logic established** The system will allow sponsors to choose from multiple suggested events, with the sponsorship automatically closing once a specific event is marked as accepted.  \- no undo logic once confirmed \- show a popup that this cant be undone to confirm please \- then only do assignment on the acceptance from events part

* **User profile edit alert implemented** A popup confirmation alert will be implemented to prevent accidental overwriting when editing user profile information. Save options shows changes made are being saved please confirm via a popup here.

* **Beta tester feedback process established** A formal feedback collection process will be established for initial beta testers to report technical issues. A form like as in raising club \- raises issue on github for the project is to be established here.

* **Platform-based email communication mandated** Full third-party white-label email integration (requiring user logins) is rejected to preserve audience trust; all communication will remain platform-based.

* **Ticket proof visibility added to dashboard** The capability to view and verify ticket proof directly on the administrative dashboard will be added. Already there actually no new things needed here actually.

* **Admin-only editing policy for events** Administrators will have the authority to edit event details (such as deadlines and budget) prior to completion, but event status will not be permitted to revert backward from confirmed to in-progress. But editing other things functionality needs to be there.

* **Location access required for QR scans** Location access verification (GPS/map) will be required when scanning event QR codes to prevent anti-fraud issues like screenshotting.

* **Step-based progress indicator for overview** A step-based progress indicator (e.g., Book, Attend, Upload, Verify) will be added to the overview screen to improve interface intuitiveness.

* **Gender profile field includes self-describe option** Gender profile fields will include standard options and an open text field for those who prefer to self-describe.

* **Country residence field utilizes dropdown list** The country of residence profile field will utilize a dropdown list to ensure input consistency.

* **Artist and Event Organizer profiles merged** Artist and Event Organizer accounts will be merged into a single profile type due to overlapping functionality requirements.

* **Reward release restricted to admins** The ability for brands or artists to release reward amounts will be disabled, restricting this action to administrators only.

* **Sponsorship reference numbers standardized** Sponsorship reference numbers will be standardized into a shorter, sequential format unique to specific identifiers.

* **Customized terms agreement configuration** Terms and conditions agreement configurations will be customized specifically for each user party (Audience, Brand, Artist).

### **Details**

* **Campaign Event Management**: Sakshi Gulati and Ketan Khamgaonkar discussed the functionality of linking multiple events to a single campaign. They agreed that admins should have the capability to suggest two or three event options to sponsors, after which the sponsor can select the preferred event. Once a sponsor makes a selection and the status is updated to closed, no further changes should be permitted.

* **User Profile Editing**: Ketan Khamgaonkar confirmed that the platform will include an alert system to warn administrators when they make changes to user profiles that have not yet been saved. This popup notification is intended to prevent accidental data overwriting.

* **Platform Bug Reporting**: Ketan Khamgaonkar plans to implement a feedback form for initial beta testers to report technical issues or bugs. They will analyze the submissions every 24 hours to identify and address system problems.

* **Email Customization and Branding**: Sakshi Gulati and Ketan Khamgaonkar addressed the need for branding in email communications. They discussed that while simple text and logo customization can be performed within the platform, complex branding (custom fonts, extensive imagery) may require using external email providers. Ketan Khamgaonkar noted that while white labeling via personal Gmail or Outlook logins is possible, they prefer to maintain trust by sending communications through the platform itself rather than selling audience data to brands.

* **Notification Setup**: Ketan Khamgaonkar confirmed that users can completely edit email notifications within the notification setup tab of the admin portal.

* **Ticket Proof Verification**: Sakshi Gulati expressed difficulty in viewing uploaded ticket proofs. Ketan Khamgaonkar confirmed that they need to add functionality to the dashboard so admins can view or download the uploaded proof directly, rather than relying solely on exported CSV files.

* **Event Participation Deadlines and Statuses**: Sakshi Gulati reported difficulty editing the participation deadline for events once they have passed. Ketan Khamgaonkar agreed to allow admins to edit event details like budgets and terms before completion, but they decided against allowing the status to move backward (e.g., from confirmed back to in-progress) to avoid complicating the system or enabling unauthorized edits.

* **QR Code Attendance and Fraud Prevention**: Sakshi Gulati inquired about QR code uniqueness and potential fraud. Ketan Khamgaonkar confirmed the codes are unique per event and have no expiration. They agreed to implement location-based verification using Google Maps API keys to prevent users from sharing QR codes with friends who are not present at the venue.

* **Audience Portal Overview**: Sakshi Gulati requested better visual feedback for users on the overview page, specifically regarding ticket uploads and verification status. Ketan Khamgaonkar agreed to add progress steps (book event, attend, upload ticket, verify) to make the interface more intuitive.

* **User Profile Data Collection**: Sakshi Gulati suggested adding a gender field with an option for "prefer to self-describe" via an open text field to ensure inclusivity. They also proposed adding a "country of residence" field with a dropdown menu to minimize spelling errors and facilitate accurate data filtering.

* **Account Uniqueness and Consent Management**: Ketan Khamgaonkar confirmed that while email addresses are currently unique identifiers, phone numbers could also be made unique to prevent fraud. They also discussed that newsletter and promotional consent will be tracked and exported via CSV, with preferences handled per event.

* **Artist and Event Organizer Profiles**: To streamline the registration flow, Sakshi Gulati and Ketan Khamgaonkar agreed to merge the "Artist" and "Event Organizer" options into a single registration category, as their platform functionality is essentially identical.

* **Reward Payout Restrictions**: Sakshi Gulati and Ketan Khamgaonkar agreed that brands and artists should not have the ability to release reward payments themselves. This functionality will be restricted to platform admins to maintain control.

* **Sponsored Event Creation**: Sakshi Gulati noted confusion regarding event creation. They agreed to add clear instructions within the creation portal stating that either the brand or artist can create an event and invite the other party. They also identified a need to correct logic regarding budget deduction, which was failing to update correctly after reward releases.

* **Sponsorship Reference Numbers**: Sakshi Gulati questioned the difference between event IDs and sponsorship reference numbers. Ketan Khamgaonkar noted they are distinct and proposed using sequential, shorter identifiers to make the reference numbers more readable and manageable as the platform grows.

* **Inquiry Form Handling**: Sakshi Gulati confirmed that contact form submissions are stored in the backend "inquiries" field rather than being automatically emailed or exported, which is acceptable for current operations.

* **Authentication and Terms Agreement**: Ketan Khamgaonkar acknowledged that the password reset page is incomplete and committed to adding it. They also discussed configuring unique terms of service agreements for different user parties (brand, artist, audience) during the sign-up process.

* **Administrative and Business Setup**: Sakshi Gulati reported on their failed attempts to use the website Recraft for logo design, describing the results as generic and poor. Sakshi Gulati also provided an update on company registration, noting the process has started, and confirmed the acquisition of the required domain and plans for Google Workspace email addresses.

* **Meeting Schedule and Deliverables**: The participants scheduled their next catch-up for Thursday at 7:30 PM (Sakshi Gulati's time). Ketan Khamgaonkar committed to completing the requested platform updates, including the feedback form and email template refinements, before that meeting.
